cards.limitationsEn: All details come from the release notes, with no backtest returns, error margins, or comparative experiments provided. The scoring fix applies only to new settlements; already settled records keep the old convention, so resumed backtests mix both conventions, and the notes recommend a new run for like-for-like comparison. Availability of the subscription path depends on OpenAI's sign-in mechanism and account plan, and the notes do not state regional, quota, or stability limits.
cards.titleEn: TradingAgents v0.7.0 Adds ChatGPT Subscription Support and Backtest Scoring Fix
keyPointsEn: A new chatgpt provider runs on a ChatGPT Plus or Pro subscription, with login and logout commands for managing sign-in.
Decision scoring now uses the first close after the decision date, fixing use of later news at the decision-date close.
The interactive CLI notes newer releases at start-up, checks at most once a day in the background, can be disabled by an environment variable, and never checks in runs without a terminal.
cards.whyItMattersEn: For users on a ChatGPT subscription, this release lowers the barrier to entry by avoiding separate API key management. The scoring fix makes backtests and memory logs better reflect information actually available at decision time, but upgraders should note that mixing old and new conventions introduces comparison bias.
keyPoints: 新增 chatgpt 提供方，支持用 ChatGPT Plus 或 Pro 订阅运行，并提供 login 与 logout 命令管理登录。
决策计分改为决策日之后首个收盘价，以修正决策日当天无法获取后续新闻却被用于评分的问题。
交互式 CLI 启动时会提示新版本，后台每天最多检查一次，也可用环境变量关闭，无终端运行不检查。
cards.summaryEn: TradingAgents v0.7.0 adds a chatgpt provider that signs in through a ChatGPT subscription, removing the need for an API key. The release notes say decisions are now scored from the first close after the decision date, fixing an issue where scoring at the decision-date close could use news not yet published. The upgrade notes warn that already settled records keep the old convention, so a backtest resumed with run_id mixes both conventions.
cards.title: TradingAgents v0.7.0 新增 ChatGPT 订阅支持与回测计分修正
cards.summary: TradingAgents v0.7.0 新增 chatgpt 提供方，可通过 ChatGPT 订阅登录并运行，无需 API 密钥。发布说明称决策改为按决策日之后首个收盘价计分，以修复此前按决策日收盘价评估时可能用到当时尚未发布新闻的问题。升级说明提醒，已结算的历史记录仍保留旧口径，因此用 run_id 续跑的回测会混合两种计分方式。
cards.whyItMatters: 对使用 ChatGPT 订阅的用户，这一版本降低了接入门槛，无需单独管理 API 密钥。计分时点的修正使回测与记忆日志的评估更贴近决策时真正可获得的信息，但升级者需注意新旧口径混用会带来比较偏差。
cards.limitations: 以上内容均来自发布说明，未提供回测收益、误差幅度或对比实验数据。计分修正只对新的结算生效，已结算记录仍保留旧口径，因此续跑回测会混合两种口径；发布说明建议另起新 run 才能做同口径比较。订阅方式的可用性取决于 OpenAI 的登录机制与账户计划，发布说明未说明地区、配额或稳定性限制。
cards.description: 该版本允许通过 ChatGPT Plus 或 Pro 订阅运行模型，而非必须使用 API 密钥，并修正了决策计分时点：决策改为按决策日之后首个收盘价计分，避免用当时无法获知的新闻评分。这些变化既降低使用门槛，也提高了回测口径的严谨性。
cards.descriptionEn: This release lets the model run through a ChatGPT Plus or Pro subscription instead of an API key, and fixes decision scoring to use the first close after the decision date, so decisions are not graded with news that was unavailable at the time. These changes lower the access barrier and tighten the evaluation basis of backtests.

cards.limitationsEn: The quantum experiments are interpreted by the authors only as API-level quantum control and hardware portability evidence, not as proof of quantum advantage or algorithmic superiority. Validation is primarily software testing and demonstration, without systematic performance comparisons or statistical significance conclusions for adaptive control versus fixed strategies across domains.
cards.titleEn: DeepUnfolding Agent: Exposing Deep Unfolded Adaptive Control as an API Service
keyPointsEn: The framework separates controller intelligence from domain execution via a strategy registry, diagnostic-to-state adapter, controller factory, safety guard, executor abstraction, feedback update path, SQLite persistence, Docker deployment, and reproducible benchmark scripts.
The implementation supports classical, quantum-aware, hybrid, Qiskit Aer, and optional IBM Quantum processing execution pathways.
Validation covers unit, schema, API, safety, orchestration, quantum execution, checkpointing, and Docker tests, and demonstrates external-user fixed versus adaptive workflows across multiple domains.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Exposing adaptive control logic as a reusable and traceable service layer can reduce duplicated implementations in task-specific scripts, support safety validation, and enable fair comparison across execution environments; the quantum experiments are interpreted by the authors as API-level quantum control and hardware portability evidence.
cards.originalTitle: DeepUnfolding_Agent: A Classical_Quantum Adaptive Control API
keyPoints: 框架通过策略注册表、诊断到状态适配器、控制器工厂、安全守卫、执行器抽象、反馈更新路径、SQLite持久化、Docker部署与可复现基准脚本，将控制器智能与领域执行分离。
实现支持经典、量子感知、混合、Qiskit Aer及可选IBM量子处理执行路径。
验证覆盖单元、模式、API、安全、编排、量子执行、检查点与Docker测试，并在多领域演示外部用户固定与自适应工作流。
cards.summaryEn: The paper presents DeepUnfolding Agent, a schema-driven FastAPI platform that exposes deep unfolded adaptive control as an external software service. External executors register a strategy schema, submit round-level diagnostic variables, receive schema-bounded control actions, and return feedback for controller updates. The authors validate the software through unit, schema, API, safety, orchestration, quantum execution, checkpointing, and Docker tests, and demonstrate fixed versus adaptive workflows in finance, healthcare, genomics, transport, noisy quantum simulation, and IBM Quantum hardware execution.
cards.title: DeepUnfolding Agent：将深度展开自适应控制外置为API服务
cards.summary: 论文提出DeepUnfolding Agent，一个模式驱动的FastAPI平台，把深度展开自适应控制作为外部软件服务暴露。外部执行器注册策略模式、提交轮级诊断变量，接收模式约束的控制动作并返回反馈以更新控制器。作者通过单元、模式、API、安全、编排、量子执行、检查点与Docker测试验证软件，并在金融、医疗、基因组、交通、噪声量子模拟及IBM量子硬件上演示固定与自适应工作流。
cards.whyItMatters: 将自适应控制逻辑外置为可复用、可追踪的服务层，有助于减少任务特定脚本中的重复实现，支持安全验证与跨执行环境的公平比较；量子实验被作者解释为API级量子控制与硬件可移植性证据。
cards.limitations: 量子实验仅被作者解释为API级量子控制与硬件可移植性证据，并非量子优势或算法性能优越性的证明。验证以软件测试与演示为主，尚未提供跨领域自适应控制相对固定策略的系统性性能对比或统计显著性结论。
cards.description: 该工作将深度展开自适应控制逻辑从训练脚本中解耦，以FastAPI服务形式提供策略注册、诊断变量提交、受模式约束的控制动作返回与反馈更新，旨在提升复用性、可重复性与跨执行环境公平比较。
cards.descriptionEn: This work decouples deep unfolded adaptive control logic from training scripts and exposes it as a FastAPI service for strategy registration, diagnostic submission, schema-bounded control actions, and feedback updates, aiming to improve reuse, reproducibility, and fair comparison across execution environments.

cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on simulations and two financial series (VIX and 10-year US Treasury yields), without coverage of other domains or high-frequency data. The main specification fixes a conservative observation-noise level; noise-estimating variants improve predictive accuracy but reduce segmentation sparsity and event alignment. The regime-specific-means variant is compared only with a fitted stationary Gaussian process, not broader baselines. Conclusions do not constitute investment advice.
cards.titleEn: Time-Partitioning Gaussian Process Mixture Model for Identifying Nonstationary Regimes
keyPointsEn: The model combines a Pitman-Yor prior with regime-specific Gaussian processes and learns the discount parameter to adapt to homogeneous or heterogeneous regime lengths.
A split-merge Metropolis-within-Gibbs sampler with exact Gibbs boundary updates jointly learns change points and hyperparameters while quantifying uncertainty.

Applied to VIX and 10-year US Treasury yields, it identifies regimes aligned with market and monetary-policy events, but noise-estimating variants improve predictive accuracy at the cost of sparser and less event-aligned segmentations.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides an interpretable regime-identification framework for nonstationary time-series dependence, distinguishing persistent shifts from transient shocks and explicitly quantifying segmentation uncertainty. The interpretability-predictive accuracy trade-off is relevant for financial volatility modeling and monetary-policy event analysis.
keyPoints: 模型结合Pitman-Yor先验与状态特定高斯过程，学习折扣参数以适应同质或异质状态长度。
采用split-merge Metropolis-within-Gibbs采样器与精确Gibbs边界更新，联合学习变化点和超参数并量化不确定性。
在VIX和10年期美债收益率上识别出与市场及货币政策事件对齐的状态，但估计观测噪声的变体在提升预测精度的同时降低分段稀疏性。
cards.summaryEn: TPGPMM models contiguous segmentations with an adaptive Pitman-Yor prior and allows regime-specific Gaussian processes to capture non-Markovian dependence, jointly learning change points and hyperparameters. Simulations show recovery of regime structure, and applications to VIX and 10-year US Treasury yields identify regimes aligned with major market and monetary-policy events. Variants estimating observation noise improve predictive accuracy but yield less sparse or less event-aligned segmentations, while a regime-specific-means variant fits better than a fitted stationary Gaussian process and forecasts about as accurately.
cards.title: 时间分区高斯过程混合模型识别非平稳状态
cards.summary: TPGPMM通过自适应Pitman-Yor先验对连续分段建模，并允许各状态内使用高斯过程刻画非马尔可夫依赖，从而学习变化点与超参数。模拟实验表明模型能恢复状态结构；在VIX和美债收益率数据上，识别出的状态与重大市场及货币政策事件一致。作者指出，估计观测噪声的变体提升预测精度，但分段稀疏性和事件对齐性下降；状态特定均值变体优于拟合的平稳高斯过程且预测精度相当。
cards.whyItMatters: 为时间序列非平稳依赖提供可解释的状态识别框架，能区分持续状态变化与短暂冲击，并显式量化分段不确定性；其揭示的可解释性与预测精度权衡对金融波动建模和货币政策事件分析有参考价值。
cards.limitations: 证据基于模拟和两个金融序列（VIX与10年期美债收益率），未涵盖其他领域或高频数据；主设定固定保守观测噪声，估计噪声的变体虽提升预测精度但分段稀疏性和事件对齐性下降；状态特定均值变体仅与拟合的平稳高斯过程比较，未与更广泛基线对比；结论不构成投资建议。
cards.description: 提出TPGPMM贝叶斯非参数框架，结合Pitman-Yor先验与状态特定高斯过程，自适应划分时间序列中的持续状态，无需马尔可夫假设。在VIX和10年期美债收益率上识别出与市场及货币政策事件对齐的状态，并揭示可解释性与预测精度间的权衡。
cards.descriptionEn: TPGPMM is a Bayesian nonparametric framework combining an adaptive Pitman-Yor prior with regime-specific Gaussian processes to partition time series into persistent regimes without Markovian assumptions. Applied to VIX and 10-year US Treasury yields, it identifies regimes aligned with market and monetary-policy events and highlights a trade-off between interpretability and predictive accuracy.

cards.limitationsEn: Results are based on the 30 models, 105 tasks, and 138 closed-loop environments specified in the paper, so generalization requires caution; reasoning-LLM cost comparisons depend on specific implementations and invocation methods; overall closed-loop success rates are low, and reliability of System-1 models in complex dynamic environments is not yet established.
cards.titleEn: System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
keyPointsEn: System1-Arena uniformly evaluates System-1 models and reasoning LLMs on discrete decisions and closed-loop environments.
The largest System-1 models match or exceed fast closed LLMs on non-agentic tasks with lower latency and better calibration.
In closed loops, large open LLMs achieve the highest success rate (up to 32.9%), while small System-1 models rarely succeed.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark provides comparable evidence for determining which decisions can be safely delegated to single-forward-pass System-1 models, helping trade off latency, cost, and accuracy and identify decision scenarios that require generative reasoning.
cards.originalTitle: System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
keyPoints: System1-Arena统一评估System-1模型与推理LLM在离散决策和闭环环境中的表现。
最大System-1模型在非智能体任务上匹配或超过快速闭源LLM，延迟更低且校准更好。
闭环环境中大开源LLM成功率最高（32.9%），小System-1模型很少成功。
cards.summaryEn: The paper presents System1-Arena, a benchmark with 92k questions, 105 tasks, and 138 closed-loop environments, evaluating 30 models. The largest System-1 models match or exceed fast closed LLMs in non-agentic accuracy with better-calibrated probabilities at one-quarter of the latency, while a reasoning LLM is most accurate at about 70x the cost. In closed loops, large open LLMs succeed most often (up to 32.9%), and small System-1 models rarely succeed.
cards.title: System1-Arena：哪些决策可交由快思考模型
cards.summary: 论文介绍System1-Arena基准，包含92k问题、105项任务和138个闭环环境，评估30个模型。实验显示最大System-1模型在非智能体准确率上匹配或超过快速闭源LLM，概率校准更好且延迟仅四分之一；推理LLM准确率最高但成本约70倍。闭环环境中大开源LLM成功率最高（32.9%），小System-1模型很少成功。
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准为判断哪些决策可安全交由单次前向传播的System-1模型提供了可比较的证据，有助于在延迟、成本与准确性之间做权衡，并识别需要生成式推理的决策场景。
cards.limitations: 评估结果基于论文设定的30个模型、105项任务和138个闭环环境，结论外推需谨慎；推理LLM成本对比依赖具体实现与调用方式；闭环成功率整体偏低，尚未证明System-1模型在复杂动态环境中的可靠性。
cards.description: 该研究提出System1-Arena基准，统一评估System-1模型与生成式推理模型在105项决策任务及138个闭环环境中的表现，揭示前者在非智能体决策中可匹敌快速闭源LLM，而闭环任务仍依赖大模型推理。
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces System1-Arena, a benchmark that uniformly evaluates System-1 models and generative reasoning models across 105 decision tasks and 138 closed-loop environments, revealing that System-1 models can match fast closed LLMs on non-agentic decisions while closed-loop tasks still depend on large reasoning models.

cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from the benchmark experiments described; generalization to larger graphs, different models, or real-world applications is not discussed; ablations are limited in scope and do not fully analyze component contributions.
cards.titleEn: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
keyPointsEn: Agents write Python code to directly operate on complete node and edge files, enabling relation following, node set combination, and textual evidence selection.
Tool creation and tool use co-evolve: execution feedback guides tool revision, and evolved tools determine subsequent evidence gathering.
On benchmarks across three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work shows that allowing agents to create and revise tools during search can overcome the constraints of predefined graph interfaces, enabling more flexible access to textual evidence and offering a new direction for agent design on knowledge graphs.
cards.originalTitle: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
keyPoints: 智能体通过编写Python代码直接操作完整节点和边文件，实现关系跟随、节点集组合和文本证据选择。
工具创建与工具使用协同演化：执行反馈指导工具修订，演化后的工具决定后续证据收集。
在三个领域基准上，无需训练的DKGI每个图均超过最强基线至少6.7 Hit@1点。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes DKGI, a harness where language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. Experiments show training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph across three domains. Ablations show multi-turn programming outperforms shell-only access and predefined graph tools.
cards.title: 知识图谱文件化：工具创建与使用协同演化的智能体框架
cards.summary: 论文提出DKGI框架，使语言模型智能体直接在完整节点和边文件上创建图访问工具。实验表明，无需训练的DKGI在三个领域基准上均超过最强基线至少6.7个Hit@1点。消融显示多轮编程优于仅shell访问或预定义图工具。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作表明，允许智能体在搜索过程中创建和修订工具，能突破预定义图接口的限制，更灵活地访问文本证据，为知识图谱上的智能体设计提供了新思路。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自论文所述基准实验；未讨论框架在更大规模图、不同模型或实际应用中的泛化性；消融实验范围有限，未全面分析各组件贡献。
cards.description: 提出直接知识图谱交互框架，让语言模型智能体在完整节点和边文件上直接编写工具，实现工具创建与使用协同演化，无需训练即超越基线。
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness where language model agents create tools directly over complete node and edge files, enabling co-evolution of tool creation and use without training and outperforming baselines.

cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on data collected from four specific frameworks, six benchmarks, and eight host models, so generalization claims are limited to the tested unseen frameworks and models. Repair pairs are execution-verified successful corrections and may not cover all failure types. Runtime intervention depends on systems exposing execution trajectories and supporting continuation replacement. No long-term deployment evaluation across task domains is provided.
cards.titleEn: ARIA: A Runtime Repair Framework for Learning When to Intervene in Multi-Agent Executions
keyPointsEn: Builds the ARIA dataset: 4 multi-agent frameworks, 6 benchmarks, 8 host models, and 3,953 execution-verified repair pairs.
Proposes a MAS-agnostic runtime inspection and amendment framework that integrates with any multi-agent system exposing execution trajectories and supporting continuation replacement.
Trains a compact model that moves repair search into data construction, avoiding repeated runtime trials and showing generalization across frameworks and models.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Shifting repair from offline diagnosis and trial-and-error to learnable runtime intervention can reduce task failures caused by local error propagation in multi-agent systems and provides reusable supervision data and a framework for runtime repair.
cards.originalTitle: ARIA: Runtime Inspection and Amendment for Multi-Agent Systems
keyPoints: 构建ARIA数据集：覆盖4个多智能体框架、6个基准、8个宿主模型，含3953个执行验证的修复对。
提出MAS无关的运行时检查与修正框架，可接入暴露执行轨迹且支持续接替换的任何多智能体系统。
训练紧凑模型将修复搜索移至数据构建阶段，运行时无需反复尝试替代方案，并展示跨框架与模型的泛化能力。
cards.summaryEn: Existing diagnosis of multi-agent systems relies on post-hoc analysis or repeated execution, lacking a learned policy for in-flight intervention. The authors collect over 24,000 trajectories and build a dataset of 3,953 verified repair pairs, then train a compact model to decide when, where, and how to repair at runtime. The model performs well in both post-hoc and runtime settings and generalizes to unseen frameworks and host models.
cards.title: 多智能体运行时修复框架ARIA：学习执行中干预
cards.summary: 论文指出现有多智能体系统诊断依赖事后分析或重复执行，缺乏运行中干预的学习策略。作者收集超2.4万条轨迹并构建含3953对验证修复的数据集，训练紧凑模型在运行时判断何时、何处、如何修复。实验显示该模型在事后与运行时场景均表现良好，并能泛化到未见框架与宿主模型。
cards.whyItMatters: 将修复策略从离线诊断和反复试错转为可学习的运行时干预，有助于减少多智能体系统中局部错误传播导致的整体任务失败，并为运行时修复提供可复用的监督数据与框架。
cards.limitations: 研究基于特定四个框架、六个基准和八个宿主模型收集的数据，泛化结论限于所测试的未见框架与模型；修复对均为执行验证的成功修正，可能未覆盖所有失败类型；运行时干预效果依赖系统暴露执行轨迹并支持续接替换；未提供跨任务领域的长期部署评估。
cards.description: 该研究构建了首个将失败多智能体轨迹与执行验证修复配对的大规模数据集，并提出ARIA框架，学习在运行中识别错误时机并实施修正，而非事后诊断或反复重试。
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces the first large-scale dataset pairing failed multi-agent trajectories with execution-verified repairs and presents ARIA, a framework that learns to detect and correct errors during ongoing execution rather than relying on post-hoc diagnosis or repeated re-execution.

cards.limitationsEn: The evidence is limited to the model settings, parameter choices, and benchmark results reported in the original paper; the unconditional stability claim for ADE is for the diffusion term and does not necessarily cover all model terms and discretization choices. The comparison with Longstaff-Schwartz Monte Carlo reflects accuracy and convergence only under the specific experimental configuration and cannot be generalized as universally optimal. The extensions to futures-price exercise and seasonal parameters stem from trader feedback, and the scope of their numerical validation and strength of conclusions should be judged against the actual results in the original paper. This is a numerical methods study and does not constitute investment advice.
cards.titleEn: Pricing American Commodity Options Under the Schwartz Two-Factor Model Using the Alternating Direction Explicit Method
keyPointsEn: The double-sweep ADE scheme is used to solve American commodity options under the Schwartz two-factor model and compared with the single-sweep Saul'yev alternating variant.
The governing PDE is derived, the semi-infinite domain is transformed into a rectangular computational domain, and Fichera theory is used to determine boundary conditions at the spot price limits.

The solver is implemented in C++, first validated against the closed-form European solution and Monte Carlo, then benchmarked against Longstaff-Schwartz Monte Carlo to analyze accuracy and convergence for American option pricing.
Based on feedback from a commodities trader, the framework is extended to exercise on futures prices and incorporate seasonal parameters.
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative pricing research, this work demonstrates the applicability of ADE-type finite-difference methods to multi-factor commodity option models and provides a complete pipeline from PDE derivation and boundary condition treatment to numerical benchmarking, helping researchers assess the accuracy-efficiency trade-offs of explicit-type schemes under the American early-exercise constraint.
cards.originalTitle: Pricing American Commodity Options Under the Schwartz Two-Factor Model Using the Alternating Direction Explicit (ADE) Method
keyPoints: 采用双扫描ADE格式求解Schwartz双因子模型下的美式商品期权，并与Saul'yev单扫描交替变体进行比较。
推导控制PDE，将半无限域变换为矩形计算域，并用Fichera理论确定现货价格边界处的边界条件。
在C++中实现求解器，先以欧洲期权闭式解和蒙特卡洛验证，再以Longstaff-Schwartz蒙特卡洛为基准分析美式期权定价的精度与收敛性。
根据商品交易员反馈，将框架扩展至按期货价格行权并引入季节性参数。
cards.summaryEn: The study focuses on numerical pricing of American commodity options under the Schwartz two-factor model, adopting a double-sweep ADE finite-difference scheme, deriving the governing PDE, transforming the semi-infinite domain into a rectangular computational domain, and applying Fichera theory to determine boundary conditions. The authors implement the solver in C++, first validating against the closed-form European solution and Monte Carlo, then imposing the American early-exercise constraint and benchmarking against Longstaff-Schwartz Monte Carlo to analyze numerical accuracy and convergence. The authors also extend the framework to exercise on futures prices and seasonal parameters based on feedback from a commodities trader; these extensions are reported design intentions, and their effects should be judged against the numerical results in the original paper.
cards.title: Schwartz双因子模型下美式商品期权定价的ADE方法
cards.summary: 研究聚焦Schwartz双因子模型下美式商品期权的数值定价，采用双扫描ADE有限差分格式并推导控制PDE，将半无限域转化为矩形计算域，应用Fichera理论确定边界条件。作者在C++中实现求解器，先以欧洲期权闭式解和蒙特卡洛验证，再施加美式提前行权约束并与Longstaff-Schwartz蒙特卡洛对比，分析数值精度与收敛性。作者还根据商品交易员反馈将框架扩展至期货价格行权和季节性参数；这些扩展属于作者报告的设计意图，其效果需以原文数值结果为准。
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化定价研究而言，该工作展示了ADE类有限差分方法在商品期权多因子模型中的适用性，并提供从PDE推导、边界条件处理到数值基准测试的完整流程，有助于研究者评估显式类格式在美式提前行权约束下的精度与效率权衡。
cards.limitations: 证据边界限于原文所报告的模型设定、参数选择与基准测试结果；ADE格式的无条件稳定性表述针对扩散项，不必然覆盖所有模型项与离散选择。与Longstaff-Schwartz蒙特卡洛的对比仅反映特定实验配置下的精度与收敛表现，不能外推为普遍最优方法。期货价格行权与季节性参数的扩展来自交易员反馈，其数值验证范围和结论强度需以原文实际结果为准。本文为数值方法研究，不构成任何投资建议。
cards.description: 该研究将双扫描交替方向显式（ADE）方法用于Schwartz双因子模型下的美式商品期权定价，并与Saul'yev单扫描变体进行比较；同时利用Fichera理论确定现货价格边界条件，在C++中实现求解器，并分别以欧洲期权闭式解、蒙特卡洛和Longstaff-Schwartz蒙特卡洛进行验证与基准测试，最终扩展到期货价格行权和季节性参数。其新意在于将无条件稳定的ADE格式系统应用于该定价问题并给出数值验证，为商品期权定价提供了一种兼顾显式效率与隐式稳定性的有限差分方案。
cards.descriptionEn: This study applies the double-sweep Alternating Direction Explicit (ADE) method to price American commodity options under the Schwartz two-factor model and compares it with the single-sweep Saul'yev alternating variant. It uses Fichera theory to determine boundary conditions at the spot price limits, implements the solver in C++, and validates it against the closed-form European solution, Monte Carlo, and Longstaff-Schwartz Monte Carlo, then extends the framework to exercise

cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is directional association, not causation; among the 38 events with public loss figures, market-cap-normalized reported loss and unresolved exposure overlap substantially (Pearson 0.86, Spearman 0.56), partly because exposure is often coded from the loss itself, so returns alone cannot distinguish reported loss from unresolved history; findings should not be used for investment decisions.
cards.titleEn: Verifiability Discount in Crypto Protocols: Uncertainty Persists After Vulnerability Repair
keyPointsEn: Introduces the 'verifiability discount' and a turnstile model: early withdrawal can shift a possible shortfall to remaining holders, and credible evidence becomes more valuable as exposure grows.
The VDISC framework records reported loss, exposed value, public evidence, returns, and pool flows, combining Orchard disclosures, earlier Zcash cases, and a 40-event security panel.
Orchard shows directional patterns: muted responses after repair and supply assurance; largest negative return and aggregate shielded-pool net outflow when past abuse could not be ruled out.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides a reproducible framework for pricing security events and designing disclosures in privacy protocols, highlighting that residual uncertainty can affect holder value through a 'verifiability discount.'
cards.originalTitle: Pricing the Unprovable: Ambiguity, Turnstile Runs, and the Verifiability Discount in Crypto Protocols
keyPoints: 提出“可验证性折价”与闸门模型：早期提取可将潜在缺口转移给剩余持有人，可信证据随暴露增加而更有价值。
VDISC框架记录报告损失、暴露价值、公开证据、收益与池流，结合Orchard披露、历史Zcash案例与40事件面板。
Orchard方向性模式：修复与供应保证后反应温和；承认无法排除滥用时负收益最大且屏蔽池净流出。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes a 'verifiability discount,' the potential value reduction when a privacy protocol repairs a vulnerability but cannot determine whether it was previously exploited. Using Orchard's staged disclosures, on-chain flows, and a 40-event security panel, the authors find muted market reactions after repair and supply assurance, while the largest negative return and net shielded-pool outflow coincide with acknowledgment that past abuse could not be ruled out. The authors stress these are directional patterns, not causal evidence, and loss and exposure measures overlap.
cards.title: 加密协议“可验证性折价”：漏洞修复后不确定性仍影响市场
cards.summary: 论文提出“可验证性折价”，指隐私协议修复漏洞后仍无法确定是否曾被利用而导致的潜在价值折减。基于Orchard分阶段披露、链上资金流与40个安全事件面板，作者发现修复后市场反应温和，而承认无法排除历史滥用时出现最大负收益与资金净流出。作者强调这些方向性模式并非因果证据，且损失数据与暴露度衡量存在重叠。
cards.whyItMatters: 为隐私协议的安全事件定价与信息披露设计提供可复现分析框架，提示残余不确定性可通过“可验证性折价”影响持有人价值。
cards.limitations: 证据为方向性关联而非因果；38个事件中市值归一化报告损失与未解决暴露高度重叠（Pearson 0.86，Spearman 0.56），部分因暴露度常从损失本身编码，仅凭收益无法区分已报告损失与未解决历史；结论不宜用于投资决策。
cards.description: 提出“可验证性折价”概念并用闸门模型与VDISC框架分析：隐私协议修复漏洞但无法证明是否曾被利用时，剩余持有人承担潜在缺口，市场对披露的反应呈方向性模式。
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces the verifiability discount and analyzes it using a turnstile model and the VDISC framework: when a privacy protocol repairs a vulnerability but cannot prove whether it was exploited, remaining holders bear potential shortfalls, and market responses to disclosures show directional patterns.

cards.titleEn: Local-first ai-job-search framework trends on GitHub
keyPointsEn: Built on Claude Code, covering job evaluation, CV tailoring, cover letters and interview prep.
Emphasizes running on the user's machine and being forked and owned, favoring process and data autonomy.
Appearing on GitHub Trending Daily is a community-attention signal, not a quality certification.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Job search involves substantial personal career data; keeping AI assistance local with self-owned code offers an alternative for users who value privacy and customization, and illustrates coding agents moving into personal-task scenarios.
keyPoints: 基于 Claude Code 构建，覆盖职位评估、简历定制、求职信与面试准备等环节。

According to the project description, it evaluates postings, tailors CVs, writes cover letters and prepares interviews, encouraging users to fork and own it. cards.title: 本地化求职框架 ai-job-search 登上 GitHub 趋势榜
cards.summary: GitHub 趋势榜收录了 MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search，一个基于 Claude Code、在用户本机运行的求职申请框架。按项目自述，它可以评估职位发布、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试，鼓励用户 Fork 后自行掌控。上述能力来自项目简介，页面未给出评测数据或效果验证。
cards.whyItMatters: 求职流程涉及大量个人履历与职业信息，把 AI 辅助放在本地、代码可自持，为重视隐私与可定制性的用户提供了另一种选择；同时展示了编码智能体向个人事务场景迁移的一种形态。
cards.limitations: 仅有项目简介与趋势榜记录，未见作者、发布时间之外的评测、基准或用户反馈；岗位匹配与文本生成质量取决于底层 Claude Code 与用户输入，实际效果未经验证。趋势榜反映短期关注，不代表项目成熟度或可靠性；使用前需自行评估数据与隐私风险，本卡不构成任何求职或投资建议。
cards.description: 该项目把职位评估、简历定制、求职信撰写和面试准备整合为一个在本地运行的 Claude Code 框架，用户可自行 Fork，把数据和流程掌握在自己手中。其新意在于把通用编码助手用于个人求职，并以可复制、可自行掌控的开源形式提供，对关注隐私和流程可控的求职者具有参考价值。
cards.descriptionEn: The project packages job evaluation, CV tailoring, cover-letter writing and interview prep into a Claude Code framework that runs locally and can be forked. Its novelty lies in applying a general coding assistant to personal job hunting in a copyable, self-owned open-source form, which is useful for job seekers who value privacy and process control.

cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions rely on the futures replication approach and specific model assumptions; numerical experiments validate only the considered scenarios and do not cover all collateral currency combinations or market conditions. Practical application requires careful assessment with specific contract and market parameters.
cards.titleEn: Impact of Collateral Currency Choice on Differential Swap Pricing
keyPointsEn: Allows the collateral account and contractual cash flows to be in different currencies, extending the existing differential swap pricing framework.
Through discounting adjustments and payment-date weights, the choice of collateral currency has a non-trivial effect on valuation and risk management.
Numerical experiments validate the closed-form formulas and show that collateral effects can produce valuation adjustments and that futures hedges are effective under discrete rebalancing.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Against the background of the LIBOR-to-risk-free-rate transition and standardized collateralized trading, collateral currency is no longer merely a credit risk mitigant; its choice affects the valuation and hedging of differential swaps through discounting and payment-date weights, offering reference for related pricing practices.
cards.originalTitle: Choice of Collateral Currency in Differential Swaps
keyPoints: 允许抵押账户与合约现金流使用不同货币，扩展了原有差异化互换定价框架。
通过折现调整和支付日权重，抵押货币选择对估值和风险管理产生非平凡影响。
数值实验验证闭式公式，并显示抵押效应可产生估值调整、期货对冲在离散再平衡下有效。
cards.summaryEn: The study extends results of Bickersteth et al. by allowing the collateral account to be denominated in a currency different from that of contractual cash flows, and derives explicit pricing and hedging strategies using a futures-based replication approach. Numerical experiments validate the closed-form formulas, show that collateral effects can produce valuation adjustments, and confirm the effectiveness of futures hedges under discrete rebalancing. The authors argue that the choice of collateral currency has a non-trivial effect on valuation and risk management, which is their view rather than a bare factual statement.
cards.title: 抵押货币选择对差异化互换定价的影响
cards.summary: 研究扩展了Bickersteth等人的结果，允许抵押账户以不同于合约现金流的货币计价，并采用基于期货的复制方法推导显式定价与对冲策略。数值实验验证了闭式公式，显示抵押效应可产生估值调整，并确认离散再平衡下期货对冲的有效性。作者认为抵押货币选择对估值和风险管理有非平凡影响，这是其观点而非单纯事实陈述。
cards.whyItMatters: 在LIBOR向无风险利率过渡、抵押交易标准化的背景下，抵押货币不再仅是信用风险缓释工具，其选择会通过折现和支付日权重影响差异化互换的估值与对冲，为相关定价实践提供参考。
cards.limitations: 结论基于期货复制方法和特定模型假设，数值实验仅验证所设情形；未涵盖所有抵押货币组合或市场条件，实际应用需结合具体合约与市场参数审慎评估。
cards.description: 本文在已有框架上允许抵押账户与合约现金流使用不同货币，给出差异化互换的显式定价与对冲策略，并揭示抵押货币通过折现调整和支付日权重影响估值与风险管理。
cards.descriptionEn: This paper extends an existing framework to allow the collateral account to be denominated in a currency different from contractual cash flows, derives explicit pricing and hedging strategies for differential swaps, and shows how collateral currency affects valuation and risk management through discounting adjustments and payment-date weights.

cards.limitationsEn: The experiment only measures observable input reliance and numerical recognition, and does not establish internal reasoning mechanisms or realized return predictability. Results are qualified by answer encoding, wording, context, and checkpoint conversion controls, and generalization to real markets and calibrated probabilities from synthetic data and a specific protocol requires caution.
cards.titleEn: LLM Financial Forecasts: Momentum and Commentary Tone Outweigh Earnings Surprise
keyPointsEn: The study uses synthetic earnings announcements in a controlled experiment, independently reversing three input variables: momentum, commentary tone, and earnings surprise.
The primary EPS contrast range is wide (-0.19 to 86.80 percentage points), and tone and momentum effects exceed EPS in most models.
Natural-word numerical diagnostic accuracy ranges from 51.0% to 95.8%, but results are qualified by answer encoding, wording, context, and checkpoint conversion controls.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study provides observable evidence of input reliance in language model financial forecasts, suggesting outputs may over-rely on non-fundamental signals like momentum or commentary tone, with reference value for understanding model bias and assessing forecast reliability.
cards.originalTitle: Momentum, Commentary Tone, and Earnings Surprise in LLM Financial Forecasts
keyPoints: 研究使用合成财报公告进行受控实验，独立反转动量、评论语气和盈利意外三个输入变量。
主要EPS对比幅度范围较宽（-0.19至86.80个百分点），且语气和动量的影响在多数模型中超过EPS。
自然词数值诊断准确率介于51.0%至95.8%，但结果受答案编码、措辞、上下文和检查点转换控制的影响。
cards.summaryEn: The study constructs synthetic earnings announcements that independently manipulate 20-day momentum, non-informational commentary tone, and whether actual EPS beats a manipulated consensus, to observe language model forecast input reliance. Facts: across six instruction/chat checkpoints, the primary EPS contrast ranges from -0.19 to 86.80 percentage points; in five models the tone contrast magnitude exceeds EPS, and momentum also exceeds EPS in five. Author's view: the experiment measures observable input reliance and numerical recognition, not internal reasoning mechanisms or realized return predictability.
cards.title: LLM财报预测：动量与评论语气影响超过盈利意外
cards.summary: 研究构建合成财报公告，独立操控20日动量、非信息性评论语气和实际EPS是否超过被操纵的共识预期，以观察语言模型预测的输入依赖。事实：在六组指令/聊天检查点中，主要EPS对比幅度从-0.19到86.80个百分点不等；五个模型中语气对比的幅度超过EPS，动量幅度也在五个模型中超过EPS。作者观点：该实验测量可观察的输入依赖和数字识别，而非内部推理机制或实际收益可预测性。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提供了语言模型财务预测中输入依赖的可观察证据，提示模型输出可能过度依赖动量或评论语气等非基本面信号，对理解模型偏差和评估预测可靠性具有参考价值。
cards.limitations: 实验仅测量可观察的输入依赖和数字识别，并未建立内部推理机制或实际收益可预测性。结果受答案编码、措辞、上下文和检查点转换控制的影响，且基于合成数据与特定协议，外推到真实市场和校准概率需谨慎。
cards.description: 该研究通过合成财报公告控制输入变量，揭示语言模型财务预测对非基本面信号的依赖程度，有助于理解模型输出偏差的来源。
cards.descriptionEn: The study uses synthetic earnings announcements to control input variables, revealing language models' reliance on non-fundamental signals and helping understand sources of model output bias.

The current input is insufficient to judge actual effectiveness or applicability.

cards.title: AI 编码代理的长期记忆与交接方案
cards.summary: 该项目在 GitHub Trending Daily 出现，自述目标是解决代理编码 CLI 的长期记忆问题，并促进不同代理供应商之间的交接。事实层面仅能确认项目定位与来源，未提供架构、性能或效果数据。作者观点可视为对代理记忆与供应商可迁移性的需求判断。
cards.whyItMatters: 代理编码工具常需在多轮任务中保持上下文，若记忆层可脱离单一厂商，切换工具时可能减少重复说明与上下文重建。但当前输入不足以判断其实际效果与适用性。
cards.limitations: 输入仅为 GitHub Trending Daily 中的项目条目与一句自述摘要，未包含代码结构、支持的代理工具、记忆存储方式、评测指标或对比实验。因此无法确认其可用性、性能、安全性及跨厂商交接的真实效果，相关判断需以项目仓库实际内容为准。
cards.description: 本卡介绍 GitHub 项目 akitaonrails/ai-memory，其定位是为代理式编码命令行工具提供长期记忆，并方便在不同代理厂商之间交接。新意在于把长期记忆做成独立于单一代理供应商的层；有用之处在于减少切换工具时的上下文重建成本，但输入未给出实现细节与评测结果。
cards.descriptionEn: This card introduces the GitHub project akitaonrails/ai-memory, positioned as long-term memory for agentic coding CLIs and as a way to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors. Its novelty lies in a memory layer independent of a single agent vendor; its usefulness would be reducing context rebuild when switching tools, but the input provides no implementation details or evaluation results.

cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions are based on a simulated Bertrand duopoly with tabular Q-learning agents matching Calvano et al. (2020), without covering other learning algorithms, market structures, or real market data; the dynamic programming deviation calculation relies on frozen partner strategies, and extrapolation to real antitrust enforcement requires caution.
cards.titleEn: Auditing the Punishment Mechanism in Q-Learning Pricing Agents: Collusion Without Deterrence
keyPointsEn: In 9 of 10 converged pairs (914 of 1,024), a single attractor's basin is the entire state space, so every price perturbation returns to the original state, and a forced price increase triggers the same retaliatory pattern as an undercut.
Re-matching frozen agents from independent runs collapses coordination by 80%, indicating that co-training produces a narrow, dyad-specific basin of attraction.

The one-period undercut is unprofitable in 92% of pairs, but the optimal deviation computed by dynamic programming profits by 17.5% on average; the punishment scheme deters only the deviation no optimizer would choose.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This audit shows that high prices and the impulse-response pattern alone are insufficient to establish a learned punishment mechanism, so the inferential basis of the standard algorithmic collusion test needs reconsideration; moreover, pairing-disruption remedies may have limited effect because coordination depends on specific pairings.
cards.originalTitle: Algorithmic Collusion Without Deterrence: Auditing the Punishment Mechanism in Q-Learning Pricing Agents
keyPoints: 在10对收敛代理中的9对（914/1024），单一吸引子的盆地是整个状态空间，任何价格扰动都返回原状态，强制涨价与降价触发相同报复模式。
将独立运行的冻结代理重新配对后，协调性下降80%，表明共训产生的是狭窄的、特定于配对关系的吸引盆地。
单期降价在92%的配对中不获利，但基于动态规划计算的最优偏离平均获利17.5%，惩罚机制只威慑了优化器不会选择的偏离。
cards.summaryEn: Independent tabular Q-learning agents in a simulated Bertrand duopoly converge to supracompetitive prices, which seminal work attributes to a learned reward-punishment scheme. The authors replicate the impulse-response pattern but find, with frozen policies, that it does not identify a mechanism: a single attractor's basin covers the entire state space, and any perturbation triggers the same retaliation. Dynamic programming shows that the optimal deviation profits by 17.5% on average, while the one-period deviation is unprofitable but not chosen by an optimizer; collusion survives because deviation is never tried.
cards.title: Q学习定价代理的惩罚机制审计：共谋无需威慑
cards.summary: 独立表格Q学习代理在模拟伯特兰双寡头中收敛至超竞争价格，既有研究将此归因于习得的奖励-惩罚机制。作者复现冲动-响应模式，但在冻结策略下发现该模式不能识别机制：单一吸引子的盆地覆盖整个状态空间，任何扰动都引发相同报复。动态规划显示最优偏离平均获利17.5%，单期偏离不获利但非优化器选择，共谋因偏离从未被尝试而存活。
cards.whyItMatters: 该审计表明，仅凭高价和冲动-响应模式不足以证明存在学习到的惩罚机制，标准算法共谋测试的推断基础需要重新审视；同时，针对配对中断的补救措施可能因协调依赖于特定配对关系而效果有限。
cards.limitations: 结论基于与Calvano等（2020）一致的模拟伯特兰双寡头环境和表格Q学习代理，未涉及其他学习算法、市场结构或真实市场数据；动态规划偏离计算依赖于冻结的伙伴策略，外推至现实反垄断执法需谨慎。
cards.description: 该研究复现了Calvano等（2020）的模拟环境，但通过冻结策略和动态规划审计发现，Q学习代理的高价共谋并非源于学习到的惩罚机制；仅在单期偏离上观察到报复，而最优偏离仍可获利。这挑战了将高价解读为卡特尔的标准测试，并提示配对中断补救措施的效果有限。
cards.descriptionEn: The study replicates Calvano et al. (2020) but audits the punishment mechanism using frozen policies and dynamic programming; it finds that high-price collusion by Q-learning agents is not driven by a learned punishment scheme—retaliation appears only for one-period deviations, while optimal deviations remain profitable. This challenges the standard test that interprets high prices as cartels and suggests limited effectiveness of pairing-disruption remedies.

cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions rely on continuous external prices and pure arbitrage, and consider only proportional transaction costs; discrete prices, jumps, non-proportional costs, or more general market frictions are not addressed. The constructed pools implement only specific inventory schedules and no-trade boundaries, without discussing parameter calibration, empirical performance, or applicability to real market data.
cards.titleEn: Loss-versus-Rebalancing under External Proportional Transaction Costs
keyPointsEn: With a self-financing benchmark, pool and benchmark have identical liquidation wealth under pure arbitrage and continuous prices, so LVR is zero.
The zero-LVR result holds even without a pool fee as long as the external spread is positive.
Retained-fee utility-indifference pools implement admissible decreasing inventory schedules, and geometric mean pools implement constant no-trade boundaries for portfolio weights.
Liquidity providers can use pool design to specify a rebalancing trading strategy executed by arbitrageurs.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study redefines the LVR benchmark under external proportional transaction costs, showing traditional LVR may vanish under certain conditions and offering an investment perspective in which pool design specifies rebalancing strategies. This helps clarify the economic meaning and design space of AMM liquidity provision.
cards.originalTitle: Loss-versus-rebalancing with external proportional transaction costs
keyPoints: 以自融资策略为基准时，纯套利与连续价格下池与基准清算财富相同，LVR为零。
即使池费用为零，只要外部价差为正，上述零LVR结论仍成立。
构造保留费用效用无差异池实现可容许递减库存路径，构造几何平均池实现组合权重的常数无交易边界。
流动性提供者可借池设计指定由套利者执行的再平衡交易策略。
cards.summaryEn: The author studies liquidity provision in automated market makers when external trading incurs proportional transaction costs, with a benchmark self-financing strategy holding the same total risky inventory and trading at external bid and ask. Under continuous external prices and pure arbitrage, the pool and benchmark have identical liquidation wealth whenever the pool fee or external spread is positive, so LVR relative to this transaction-cost benchmark is zero. The author constructs retained-fee utility-indifference pools implementing admissible decreasing inventory schedules and geometric mean pools implementing feasible constant no-trade boundaries, offering an investment interpretation of liquidity provision.
cards.title: 外部比例交易成本下的损失与再平衡研究
cards.summary: 作者研究外部交易存在比例成本时自动做市商的流动性提供问题，基准为持有相同总风险库存并按外部买卖价交易的自融资策略。在连续外部价格与纯套利条件下，只要池费用或外部价差为正，池与基准的清算财富相同，因此相对该交易成本基准的LVR为零。作者进一步构造保留费用效用无差异池与几何平均池，实现可容许的递减库存路径与可行的常数无交易边界，并给出流动性提供的投资解释。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究将LVR放在外部比例交易成本框架下重新定义基准，指出在特定条件下传统LVR可能消失，并给出通过池设计指定再平衡策略的投资视角，有助于理解AMM流动性提供的经济含义与设计空间。
cards.limitations: 结论依赖连续外部价格与纯套利假设，且仅考虑比例交易成本；未涉及离散价格、跳跃、非比例成本或更一般市场摩擦；构造的池仅实现特定库存路径与无交易边界，未讨论参数校准、实证表现或对真实市场数据的适用性。
cards.description: 该研究在外部市场存在比例交易成本时，重新审视自动做市商流动性提供的损失与再平衡（LVR）基准，发现以自融资策略为基准时，纯套利条件下LVR为零；并构造了保留费用的效用无差异池与几何平均池，将流动性提供解释为可指定再平衡交易策略的投资行为。
cards.descriptionEn: This study re-examines the loss-versus-rebalancing (LVR) benchmark for automated market maker liquidity provision when external trading incurs proportional transaction costs. Using a self-financing strategy as benchmark, it shows LVR is zero under pure arbitrage, and constructs retained-fee utility-indifference pools and geometric mean pools, interpreting liquidity provision as an investment that specifies a rebalancing trading strategy.
